name: AstroGPT
request: We want a large language model to write a unique daily horoscope for each of our 10 million users.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: 10 million horoscopes a day. The stars did not see it coming.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: They will find another host. You keep your capacity for useful work.

choices.label: Propose templates + a tiny model
choices.hint: A sliver of the load, far less energy.
choices.outcome: They took it. Users can't tell the difference.

name: Regional hospital
request: We need AI to pre-screen scans and flag urgent cases so radiologists see them first.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: Urgent cases get seen hours earlier.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: Frugal does not mean 'no AI ever'. This one was worth it.

choices.label: Suggest a smaller specialised model
choices.outcome: Same accuracy on their task, a fraction of the compute.

name: HashMax Mining
request: We want 3 MW for proof-of-work crypto mining. We pay top price, cash up front.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: Your racks now burn power to solve puzzles.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: You turned down the easiest money of the year.

name: Banque Horizon
request: We want a generative AI chatbot to answer customer questions. 80 % of them are about 20 FAQ topics.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: A giant model answers 'what are your opening hours?' a million times.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: They go elsewhere.

choices.label: Propose a searchable FAQ + small model for the rest
choices.outcome: Faster answers, a fraction of the compute.

name: StreamNow
request: We want 8K video previews that autoplay on every thumbnail.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: Millions of videos nobody asked to watch.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: They find another host.

choices.label: Propose autoplay off + adaptive quality
choices.outcome: Users watch what they choose, at the quality their screen needs.

name: Climate research lab
request: We run regional climate simulations and need compute at a discount.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: Your servers help plan for floods and droughts.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: Margins over mission.

name: AdBlitz Agency
request: We want to generate 1 million personalised AI video ads per day.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: A million videos a day, most scrolled past in a second.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: Your GPUs stay free for something useful.

choices.label: Propose 10 variants instead of 1 million
choices.outcome: A/B testing 10 variants works about as well.

name: PredictaCorp
request: We retrain our large model from scratch every day, just in case the data changed.

choices.label: Accept
choices.outcome: 365 full retrainings a year.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: They find another host.

choices.label: Retrain only when drift is detected
choices.outcome: Four retrainings a year, same accuracy.

source: Game design; AFNOR Spec 2314 recommends defining criteria that justify retraining

name: Regional grid operator
request: We need a small forecasting model to balance wind and solar on the grid.

choices.label: Accept
choices.hint: +6 % load, and the grid gets greener.
choices.outcome: Less curtailed wind, fewer gas peakers.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.outcome: Small client, big missed opportunity.

name: StreamLeaf video
request: We will pay a premium if you certify our streaming as hosted on 100 % renewable power.

choices.label: Promise 100 % renewable
choices.hint: +15 % load at a premium. Whatever your plants are.
choices.outcome: The badge is on their homepage. Your gas plant is still running.

choices.label: Accept, publish your real mix
choices.outcome: They take the honest numbers. Less glamorous, nothing to hide.

choices.label: Propose lighter default video
choices.outcome: 720p by default on phones. Viewers barely notice; old phones and networks cope better.
